s00F6DB.name: Scroll screen to follow Mario
summary: Per-frame camera update, called via JSL from the level game modes. Builds the left/right scroll lines from the dead-zone centre [$142A],
moves layer 1 toward Mario (horizontal and vertical), derives layer 2 scroll from it, and stores the per-frame scroll deltas.
Writes [$1A]-[$1D] (layer 1 X/Y), [$1E]/[$20] (layer 2 X/Y), deltas [$17BC]-[$17BF], and copies the new positions to [$1462]-[$1469].
Subroutines: $00F7F4 vertical scroll (Y = A limit), $00F8AB look-ahead adjustment. Uses tables DATA_00F69F-00F6CF.

s00F8DF.name: Table: Y tile offsets by platform tilt

s00F8E8.name: Table: Mario ceiling Y limit per boss room
summary: 16-bit words indexed by [$13FC] * 2: $002A, $002A, $0012, $0000, $FFED. Entry $2A also enables extra checks in the routine at $00F8F2.

s00F8F2.name: Mario vs Mode 7 boss room platform/ceiling
summary: Called from Mario's per-frame code ($00CD1F) in Mode 7 boss rooms. If [$0D9B] bit 6 is set: clamps Mario's Y to the ceiling limit
from DATA_00F8E8, then (for entry $2A) tests Mario against a boss-room object. If bit 6 is clear: tests Mario against the tilting
platform ($00F9A8, using JSL $01:CC9D) and applies the slope/standing response. Semantics are inferred; exact object not confirmed.

s00FA10.name: Unused clear sprites, then slope pointer setup
summary: $00FA10: Unused. Clears the 12 sprite status bytes and returns (RTL).
$00FA19: sets up a long pointer in [$05]-[$07] ($00:E632, probably a slope steepness table), reads [[$82]+A-$6E] into [$08],
and returns Y = (([$0A] & 15) | (value * 16 low byte)) as an index. Called from sprite code in banks 01 and 02 (JSL).
Parameters: A = tile number ($6E-$D5 range). Returns: Y = index; [$00] = [$0C] & 15, [$01] = value * 16.

FlatPalaceSwitch.name: Spawn Flat Palace Switch
summary: Starts the ground shake and creates the Flat Palace Switch (sprite $60) in slot 2 at the position of the block Mario hit.
Position: X = [$9A] & $F0 (+[$9B]), Y = ([$98] & $F0) + $10 (+[$99] + carry). Sets status 8 and the timer [$1540,Y] = $5F.

TriggerGoalTape.name: Level end: clear effects, start sprite loop
summary: Clears P-balloon [$13F3], [$1891], sprite respawn timer, generator number and [$18DD], then falls into the sprite loop below.

LvlEndSprLoopStrt.name: Level end: process every sprite
summary: Loops over sprite slots 11..0. Sprites with status < 8 are skipped. A sprite carried by Mario (status $0B) becomes a powerup.
Goal tape, and on-screen sprites without tweaker bit $20 in [$1686], become status 6 (turn into coin). Others are erased unless
tweaker bit 1 of [$190F] (don't erase) is set. Afterwards all 8 extended sprites are cleared.

LvlEndNextSprite.name: Level end: next sprite, clear extended sprites
summary: Decrements the sprite index and loops; when done, clears all 8 extended sprite slots and returns (RTL).

s00FADF.name: Table: powerup sprite given at level end
summary: 28 sprite numbers, four groups of 7 indexed by Mario powerup/state. Group 0: normal. Group 1 (+7): carrying springboard or P-switch.
Group 2 (+14): carrying key. Group 3 (+21): carrying baby Yoshi. $74 mushroom, $75 flower, $76 star, $77 feather, $E0-$FF = 1-Up variants.

s00FAFB.name: Table: item box contents to match

LvlEndPowerUp.name: Level end: choose bonus powerup for carried sprite
summary: Used when Mario carries a sprite past the goal. Picks an index X from Mario's powerup (or Yoshi), adds 7/14/21 depending on the carried
sprite (springboard/P-switch, key, baby Yoshi), reads DATA_00FADF, and replaces the result by a 1-Up ($78) if it equals the current
item box contents. Values >= $E0 become a 1-Up, with the low nibble saved in [$0F]. Parameters: Y = sprite slot.

LvlEndStoreSpr.name: Level end: convert sprite to bonus powerup
summary: Makes sprite slot Y the chosen powerup, re-initialises it, gives it status $0C (goal tape powerup) with an upward launch, plays SFX $0C
and spawns a smoke sprite at its position in the first free of 4 slots.
Parameters: A = sprite number, Y = slot, [$0F] = extra value for [$1594,Y].

LvlEndSprCoins.name: Level end sprites to coins (long wrapper)
summary: Sets the data bank to $00, calls LvlEndSprCoinsRt and returns with RTL. Called from the sprite status 6 handler in bank 01.
